fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook just inside the passes (C&R); surf mangrove snapper, reds, snook, black drum, sheepshead; fall bait moving. LEMON BAY: smaller black drum and big reds under docks; pompano in the pass; trout and juvenile gags on the flats; schools from Miserable Mile to Tom Adams. NEARSHORE: Spanish on bait in 6–7 ft; mangroves on trestles/reefs; gag season open through Sep 30. Baits: live shrimp, white bait/pinfish, cut ladyfish, spoons/soft plastics.
redtide: FWC Sep 25: K. brevis background in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 2.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (Healthy Beaches; Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/21; gulf beaches Good).
fpl: Charlotte ~2 / Sarasota ~9–149 FPL outages this morning (trackers disagree on Sarasota count); no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
